area: effects, colour, raster, motion, compositing (Photoshop, Lightroom Classic, After Effects territory)

tree.note: Read only. Paused lane SMB-PR-RETIME-OUTPUT-1 is not on this tree; only its log titles were read.

steps: Loaded all 2423 MT contracts of the five domains from the MT files; grouped by spec_heading, spec_anchor and unit_kind.

Catalogue families: every row compared with the code registries, using an identifier index over 2044 Rust files and direct reading of the kind enums; the BUILT and PARTIAL sets are this auditor's mapping. These are census, not sample.
STU-FX-131a: table order mapped to effect name through the module 14 headings, then compared with Folio and simulation records.
Clause families: rows chosen with seed 20261105, stratified by anchored and unanchored, contracts opened, code located with git grep and module headers.

classification.BUILT: behaviour exists, a test names it, and an operator path exists where one could be located
classification.GUI_ONLY_GAP: engine plus test exist, operator surface or host path not located
classification.PARTIAL: part of the clause exists, stated per family
classification.NON_CODE_OR_NOT_AN_EFFECT: spec bookkeeping, or catalogue noise such as UI dialog names

limits: No test was run. BUILT means a test exists, not that it passes on this tree.
Rows are judged at file, module-doc and test-name level, not per acceptance row. A BUILT clause may still fail a specific AC row: UNVERIFIED at AC level.
Manual and HBR obligations were seen in the contracts but not checked per MT: NOT_INSPECTED.
Name search can miss differently named code. Absence claims came from case-insensitive grep on the terms stated; any other reading is UNVERIFIED.
method.prefilter_finding: Misleads both ways. All 428 STU-FX-130 rows show anchor_in_src because one anchor covers the whole catalogue, and STU-CMP-055 rows because of the refusal list. Develop clauses STU-RAW-006..012 show none although code exists.

catalogue_noise.note: A large part of the effects domain derives from captured UI files, plugin codes and animation presets. They inflate the denominator and need a spec-owner decision. No MT was edited.

status_meaning.what_it_means: lifecycle.status is PASS_Vn only when a validation round record names that exact MT as met (evidence_rule in research/mt-status-sync-plan-20261101T000709Z.json). It says nothing about code otherwise.
why_so_few: MTs were generated from the spec and stamped PENDING, phase blocked, contract_preparation_only true, blocked_on SPEC207_PUBLICATION_AND_NEW_IMPLEMENTATION_SESSION; 2410 of these 2423 still carry that stamp.

Work runs by lane and rounds give lane verdicts: 54 round files hold about 8800 lane entries, yet only 168 distinct MT ids appear in them. Lane-entry count is a raw parse, UNVERIFIED as lanes per round.

The only sync was one-time and mechanical on 2026-11-01. Plan: 8 written, 115 excluded (88 claimed_not_validator_judged, 21 judged_not_met, 6 advanced_only). The lead then stripped MT-038 and MT-30095, leaving 6.

An MT also needs its GUI half: finding F-R49-9 and the tooltip half (D7) hold back engine-complete rows. MT-34183 Foam was written PASS_V1 at 00:07 and is PENDING blocked_on OPERATOR_SURFACE_TOOLTIP_HALF since 08:21 the same day.
status_meaning.code_ahead_of_status: Yes, by a wide margin: raster shows 0 PASS while 35 blend modes, 20 adjustments, 10 layer styles and most of develop exist with tests. Status cannot be used as a progress measure.
status_meaning.proof_field_warning: Contract proof commands name targets such as --test mt_31250 and --test contracts. Files matching tests/mt_<id> on this tree: 0. tests/contracts targets: 0. PASS rows MT-32012 and MT-32013 still carry proof status NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Proof fields are planning text, not a record of what ran.

Brush engine beyond parametric tips, and core layer commands: sampled, erodible, airbrush tips, scatter, dual, texture, wet mix, library; mixer, history, pattern-stamp brushes; merge, flatten, stamp, rasterize target; puppet and perspective warp; quick mask.

Colour infrastructure: video scopes, OCIO config runtime, OS display profile acquisition, CIEDE2000 in the engine with reference corpus, materialisation contract, HLG, ACEScct.
